subject: feat(phase-2): Complete Avalonia UI migration — themes, docking, dialogs, tray
body:
feat(phase-2): Complete Avalonia UI migration — themes, docking, dialogs, tray

## Phase 2 — Avalonia UI (92% complete, 35/38 tasks done)

### Theming System (P2-2.1.3)
- DarkTheme.axaml: Full VS2015 Dark palette — Button, TextBox, ComboBox, TreeView,
  Menu, TabControl, GridSplitter, ContextMenu, card/badge/toolbar/statusbar styles
- LightTheme.axaml: VS2015 Light counterpart
- ThemeService: runtime Apply() + LoadFromSettings/SaveToSettings

### Icon Resources (P2-2.1.4)
- 39 .ico files copied to Assets/Icons/
- IconService: protocol→icon mapping, bitmap cache, WindowIcon helper

### Main Window (P2-2.2.1–2.2.5)
- MainWindow.axaml: full menu bar (File/View/Tools/Help with keyboard shortcuts),
  toolbar with quick-connect bar, 3-panel splitter layout (tree | sessions | log),
  status bar with live connection count
- All menu items bound to ReactiveCommands (NewConnection, Import, Export,
  Options, QuickConnect, PortScanner, About, Exit)

### Docking Layout (P2-2.2.2)
- DockFactory.cs: Dock.Avalonia ProportionalDock layout (left tree + center sessions + bottom log)
- ConnectionTreeDockable, SessionsDockable (tabbed sessions), LogPanelDockable

### Connection Tree (P2-2.3.1–2.3.3)
- ConnectionTreeView.axaml: TreeDataTemplate, protocol badge, context menu
- ConnectionTreeViewModel: ObservableCollection, search filter, ReactiveCommands, demo data

### Session Tabs (P2-2.4.1–2.4.2)
- SessionsView.axaml: tab strip with state indicator, protocol badge, close button
- SessionTabViewModel, SessionsDockable.AddSession/CloseSession
- Log panel: LogEntry with level icons and colors

### Options Window (P2-2.5.1–2.5.11) — all 10 pages
- OptionsWindow.axaml: left category nav + right page area + OK/Cancel/Apply/Reset
- All 10 page ViewModels: Appearance, Connection, Security, Advanced, Updates,
  Notifications, Theme, Tabs, Credentials, Protocols
- All 10 AXAML page views with card layout, proper bindings

### Dialogs (P2-2.6.x)
- AboutDialog: logo, version, .NET/Avalonia info,

@@ -1,24 +1,36 @@
 using Avalonia;
 using Avalonia.Controls.ApplicationLifetimes;
 using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
-using mRemoteNG.Avalonia.Views;
+using mRemoteNG.Avalonia.Services;
 using mRemoteNG.Avalonia.ViewModels;
+using mRemoteNG.Avalonia.Views;
 
 namespace mRemoteNG.Avalonia;
 
 public partial class App : Application
 {
+    private TrayIconService? _trayService;
+
     public override void Initialize() =>
         AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);
 
     public override void OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted()
     {
         if (ApplicationLifetime is IClassicDesktopStyleApplicationLifetime desktop)
         {
-            desktop.MainWindow = new MainWindow
-            {
-                DataContext = AppServices.GetRequired<MainWindowViewModel>(),
-            };
+            // Apply persisted theme before showing any window.
+            ThemeService.Instance.Apply(ThemeService.Instance.CurrentTheme);
+
+            var mainVm = AppServices.GetRequired<MainWindowViewModel>();
+            var mainWindow = new MainWindow { DataContext = mainVm };
+
+            desktop.MainWindow = mainWindow;
+
+            // System tray (minimise-to-tray support).
+            _trayService = new TrayIconService();
+            _trayService.Initialize("mRemoteNG");
+
+            desktop.Exit += (_, _) => _trayService.Dispose();
         }
 
         base.OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted();
--- mRemoteNG.Avalonia/AppServices.cs
@@ -23,13 +23,29 @@ public static T GetRequired<T>() where T : notnull =>
     /// <summary>Registers application-level (non-platform) services.</summary>
     public static void Register(IServiceCollection services)
     {
-        // ViewModels
-        services.AddTransient<ViewModels.MainWindowViewModel>();
-        services.AddTransient<ViewModels.ConnectionTreeViewModel>();
+        // Core ViewModels (singleton where state must persist)
+        services.AddSingleton<ViewModels.ConnectionTreeViewModel>();
+        services.AddSingleton<ViewModels.Docking.SessionsDockable>();
+        services.AddSingleton<ViewModels.Docking.LogPanelDockable>();
+
+        // Main window — explicit factory so DI resolves constructor arg.
+        services.AddSingleton<ViewModels.MainWindowViewModel>(sp =>
+            new ViewModels.MainWindowViewModel(
+                sp.GetRequiredService<ViewModels.ConnectionTreeViewModel>()));
+
+        // Transient dialogs (new instance per open)
         services.AddTransient<ViewModels.OptionsWindowViewModel>();
+        services.AddTransient<ViewModels.QuickConnectViewModel>();
+        services.AddTransient<ViewModels.ConnectionDialogViewModel>();
+
+        // Services
+        services.AddSingleton<Services.ThemeService>(_ => Services.ThemeService.Instance);
+        services.AddSingleton<Services.TrayIconService>();
+        services.AddSingleton<Services.IconService>();
 
-        // Application services (to be expanded in Phase 2 & 3)
+        // Phase 3: protocol + connection services go here
         // services.AddSingleton<IConnectionsService, ConnectionsService>();
         // services.AddSingleton<ICredentialService, CredentialService>();
+        // services.AddSingleton<IProtocolFactory, ProtocolFactory>();
     }
 }
